newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT -- Southwest Air raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT -- Southwest Air raised.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers said it upgraded Southwest Airlines Co to outperform from neutral.
-- cited positive revenue impact from the fare increase initiated over the weekend.
-- said fare increase represents a 6.6 percent systemwide price increase which should boost unit revenues by 3.8 percent over pricing policies in effect prior to the weekend.
-- said maintains the 1997 earnings estimates of $1.55 a share.
-- said the fare increase will likely offset the early return of the excise tax, which may be reinstated by March 1 instead of July 1, as previously expected.
-- said expects Southwest's cost performance to improve in 1996.
-- said has a 12-month price target of $25 a share.
-- Southwest will meet with Wall Street analysts in New York on Wednesday.
